# Sources and methods

This invented fixture document explains how transcript origins, source ages, and filename-inferred ages are kept distinct in the automated test collection.

## Ages and dates

- **Source ages:** Archived research transcripts may record the child's age directly in their CHAT metadata (`years;months.days`).
- **Inferred ages:** When a session has no source age, the collection may display an inferred age parsed from a six-digit filename stem, always visibly labelled *(inferred from filename)* and stored separately from source ages.
- **Dates are never inferred:** Calendar dates appear only where established by source metadata and are never derived from filenames.
